amigoAnozero.title: Anozero Friend
amigoAnozero.intro: Being an «Anozero Friend» means belonging to a select group of dedicated philanthropists, art lovers and citizens, committed to creating the conditions for this biennial to take place. The purpose is also to foster a spirit of proximity that will allow you to follow the artists and curators of each edition of the biennial under exclusive conditions. Since the first edition, Anozero has very actively sought the support of local, regional, national and international companies, either through donations or service provision.
amigoAnozero.support: Since the first edition, Anozero has very actively sought the support of local, regional, national and international companies, either through donations or service provision.
amigoAnozero.impact: Supporting the biennial as its «Friend» allows it to continue to develop as one of the structural projects in the area, while simultaneously enabling the creation and circulation of works by relevant national and international artists, as well as the launch of new creators.
amigoAnozero.benefits: As an «Anozero Friend», we expect you to have access to unique actions, such as the Anozero Friends Party, the drawing of works by artists and special conditions for acquiring art multiples.
amigoAnozero.taxBenefitsText: Under the cultural patronage regime, in accordance with current legislation, contributions to the Círculo de Artes Plásticas de Coimbra/Anozero – Bienal de Coimbra fall within the concept of donation for the purposes of Article 61 and following of Decree-Law No. 215/89, of July 1st, republished and renumbered by Decree-Law No. 108/2008, of July 26th, which approved the Tax Benefits Statute.
amigoAnozero.contactText: If you need to contact us: +351 910 787 255 / geral@capc.com.pt

about.title: About Anozero
about.intro: Anozero – Coimbra Biennial is an initiative proposed in 2015 by the Círculo de Artes Plásticas de Coimbra, organized together with the Coimbra City Council and the University of Coimbra, whose primary objective is to promote reflection on the circumstances of the classification of the University of Coimbra, Alta and Sofia as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
about.missionText: Emerging as an attempt to understand the symbolic and effective meaning of this new reality of the city – being a holder of World Heritage – the biennial proposes a confrontation between contemporary art and heritage, exploring the risks and multiple possibilities associated with this cultural heritage that now belongs to Humanity.
about.historyText: Anozero is, therefore, an action program for the city that, through systematic questioning about the territory in which it is inscribed, can contribute to building an active and transformative cultural era in Coimbra and the Central Region.
